limitations: The result concerns exact arithmetic, fixed scalar steps, and the two-dimensional linear family A=gamma L J, B=LJ. It does not optimize general nonlinear monotone inclusions or finite-horizon error. At the rate-optimal step for gamma>-1 the repeated root is defective, so generic trajectories have a polynomial k prefactor. The gamma=0 rate 1/sqrt(2) is prior work and is excluded from the novelty claim. The motivating preprint is recent, so contemporaneous follow-up work may not yet be indexed.
provenance: Mathematical analysis of the skew-rotation FRB/RFB recurrence from arXiv:2609.18373v1, deriving exact spectral-radius formulas, rate-optimal fixed steps, the discriminant-coalescence mechanism, and the full pure-skew rate phase across gamma=-1.
record_title: Exact rate-optimal steps for FRB/RFB on the skew-rotation family
